rule.name: peecare_development_telemetry
rule.description: Forward canonical PeeCare development telemetry to the ingestion webhook.
rule.sql:
SELECT
  topic,
  clientid AS clientId,
  username,
  qos,
  flags.retain AS retained,
  publish_received_at AS brokerReceivedAtMs,
  json_decode(payload) AS payload
FROM "products/+/devices/+/events/urination",
  "products/+/devices/+/status/battery"

compatibilityRule.name: peecare_development_legacy_status_compatibility
compatibilityRule.description: Translate one approved development legacy publisher into test-only urination events.
compatibilityRule.sql:
SELECT
  json_decode(payload) AS legacyPayload,
  username,
  qos,
  publish_received_at,
  CASE
    WHEN is_num(legacyPayload.pumpSecondsToday)
    THEN round(legacyPayload.pumpSecondsToday * 1000)
    ELSE 0
  END AS pumpDurationMs,
  uuid_v4_no_hyphen() AS compatibilityUuid
FROM "peecare/device/1/status"
WHERE clientid = '{{PEECARE_APPROVED_LEGACY_MQTT_CLIENT_ID}}'
  AND username = '{{PEECARE_APPROVED_LEGACY_MQTT_USERNAME}}'
  AND flags.retain = false
  AND is_map(legacyPayload)
  AND is_bool(legacyPayload.online)
  AND legacyPayload.online = true
  AND is_num(legacyPayload.pumpSecondsToday)
  AND legacyPayload.pumpSecondsToday >= 0
  AND legacyPayload.pumpSecondsToday <= 4294967.295

batteryCompatibilityRule.name: peecare_development_legacy_status_battery_compatibility
batteryCompatibilityRule.description: Translate an eligible development legacy status into a test-only battery event.
batteryCompatibilityRule.sql:
SELECT
  json_decode(payload) AS legacyPayload,
  qos,
  publish_received_at,
  CASE
    WHEN is_num(legacyPayload.batteryV)
    THEN legacyPayload.batteryV
    ELSE -1
  END AS batteryVolts,
  round(batteryVolts * 1000) AS batteryVoltageMv,
  CASE
    WHEN batteryVolts >= 8.5 THEN 100
    WHEN batteryVolts >= 8.0 THEN 75
    WHEN batteryVolts >= 7.5 THEN 50
    WHEN batteryVolts >= 7.0 THEN 25
    ELSE 0
  END AS batteryLevelPercent,
  uuid_v4_no_hyphen() AS compatibilityUuid
FROM "peecare/device/1/status"
WHERE is_map(legacyPayload)
  AND is_num(legacyPayload.batteryV)
  AND batteryVolts >= 0
  AND batteryVolts <= 20
